about.title: About me
paragraphs: I am a front-end developer and a Software Engineering student at UniEvangélica, in Anápolis, Brazil. My focus is the bridge between design and code: taking a prototype and shipping an interface that works on any screen, loads fast and can be used by everyone, including people who navigate with a keyboard or a screen reader.

Beyond the front-end, I have been studying cybersecurity and Docker, and I have already containerized the front-end of a real project. Away from the code, I am a lifelong Cruzeiro fan: that passion became the landing page you will find among my projects.
